title: 第25章 调教第26章 玩偶
slug: 落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆
lines: ：叶海站在床边，扭头看向坐在床上的琉璃川千代：“还愣着干什么，过来帮我穿衣服。”
他当然不是个生活不能自理的人，叶海平常也不要女仆帮忙穿衣服，因为他嫌那太慢了。
不过今天就不一样了。
就得让这个还没褪去大小姐光环的千金来做这些事，不然怎么挫她的锐气呢。
琉璃川千代低垂着眼眸，强忍着心中的羞耻从床上爬了起来，让自己绝妙的身姿透过那月白色的半透明丝绸睡衣展现在叶海面前。
她站起身，看到椅子上叶海昨晚脱下的衣服后，便迈着赤裸的小脚往那走去。
叶海的卧室内铺了一层羊毛毯，光脚踩在上面倒也不会觉得冷。
“你平常衣服会连着穿两天吗？”
看着琉璃川千代的动作，叶海冷不丁的问道。
听到叶海的话，琉璃川千代的动作顿时僵住了。
确实，哪有贵族会连着两天穿同一套衣服，就算是琉璃川千代之前逃亡的时候，也没缺了换洗的衣服。
她有些慌乱的站在原地转头看了一眼室内，在找到一个衣柜后又迈着小碎步匆忙走了过去。
但当她打开衣柜后，琉璃川千代呆了。
衣柜很大，但里面压根就没装衣服，而是一堆玩偶，甚至直接把衣柜都填满了。
或许是琉璃川千代的动作太大了，一只黑白双色的类似于熊的玩偶从上层掉了下来砸在她头上，最后落到了她脚边。
叶海无奈的摇头叹了口气：“你好歹也是公爵之女吧，难道你自己的衣服一个衣柜能放下吗？”
“衣服都在换衣间里，你……算了，安娜！”
叶海朝着门外喊了一声。
“我一直在，伯爵大人。”
门外的安娜在听到招呼的第一时间便推开了叶海卧室的房门，她早就已经带着女仆们在起居室里候着了。
叶海的卧室是个套间，外面是起居室，也可以说是书房，用来会客和处理事务的。
而睡觉所在的卧室则是在里间。
“衣服已经为您准备好了，是否需要我帮您穿上。”
安娜十分熟络的捧着一套新衣服来到了叶海三步外站着。
她已经照顾了叶海十来年了，对他的生活习惯都十分熟悉，叶海也比较习惯使唤她来做事，以至于安娜甚至可以说是城堡里的半个女仆长。
“不，你去教千代，让她来给我穿。”
“身为贴身女仆，连怎么给主人穿衣服都不知道，实在是太不敬业了。”
叶海伸手指了一下边上正处于呆滞状态的琉璃川千代。
安娜低着头用余光看了眼边上的琉璃川千代，轻声应道：“遵命，伯爵大人。”
她走到琉璃川千代身旁，语气平淡无波：“琉璃川千代小姐，请您先把这只玩偶捡起来。”
“伯爵大人的房间地面上不应该有杂物。”
琉璃川千代下意识弯腰，抱起那只黑白相间的熊玩偶，指尖触到柔软的绒毛时，才猛地意识到自己现在的模样似乎不适合见人。
她抱着玩偶僵在原地，耳尖红得几乎滴血。
安娜却像什么也没看见，只侧身让开一条路，声音依旧平静：“换衣间在这边，请随我来。”
换衣间就在卧室隔壁，推开暗门便是。
里面比卧室还大一倍，一整面墙都是落地衣柜，另一面墙则是巨大的穿衣镜和一排排抽屉。
“伯爵大人今天要穿的衣服我已经准备好了，不过之后挑选衣服这个任务或许要你来做。”
“希望你能有良好的审美，不要让我们伯爵大人在臣民们面前失了礼仪。”
content_en:
: Ye Hai stood by the bed and turned to look at Liulicawa Chiyo who was sitting on the bed: "What are you still doing? Come here and help me get dressed."
Of course, he is not a person who cannot take care of himself. Ye Hai usually does not ask the maid to help him get dressed because he thinks it is too slow.
But today is different.
We have to let this daughter, who has not lost her aura of eldest lady, do these things, otherwise how will her spirit be dampened.
"Yes..."
Liulichuan Chiyo lowered her eyes, resisting the shame in her heart and climbed up from the bed, letting her stunning figure appear in front of Ye Hai through the moon-white translucent silk pajamas.
She stood up and saw the clothes Ye Hai had taken off last night on the chair, then walked there with her bare feet.
There is a wool blanket in Ye Hai's bedroom, and you won't feel cold if you step on it with bare feet.
"Do you usually wear clothes for two days in a row?"
Looking at Liulicuan Chiyo's actions, Ye Hai asked coldly.
Hearing Ye Hai's words, Liulichuan Chiyo's movements suddenly froze.
Indeed, no noble would wear the same set of clothes for two days in a row. Even when Rurigawa Chiyo fled before, there was no shortage of change of clothes.
She stood there in a panic and turned around to look inside the room. After finding a wardrobe, she hurriedly walked over with small steps.
But when she opened the closet, Rurigawa Chiyo was stunned.
The wardrobe was large, but there were no clothes in it at all, but a bunch of dolls, which even filled the wardrobe.
Perhaps Rurigawa Chiyo's movements were too big. A black and white bear-like doll fell from the upper floor and hit her on the head, and finally landed at her feet.
"Alas..."
Ye Hai shook his head helplessly and sighed: "You are also the daughter of a duke after all. Can you fit your own clothes into a wardrobe?"
"The clothes are all in the changing room, you... forget it, Anna!"
Ye Hai shouted towards the door.
"I'm always here, Your Majesty."
Anna outside the door opened the door of Ye Hai's bedroom as soon as she heard the greeting. She had already been waiting in the living room with the maids.
Ye Hai's bedroom is a suite, and outside is the living room, which can also be said to be a study room, used for receiving guests and handling affairs.
The bedroom where you sleep is in the back room.
"The clothes are ready for you, do you need me to help you put them on?"
Anna came to Ye Hai and stood three steps away with a new set of clothes in her hands.
She has taken care of Ye Hai for more than ten years and is very familiar with his living habits. Ye Hai is also used to asking her to do things, so much so that Anna can even be said to be half the head maid in the castle.
"No, you go teach Chiyo and let her dress me."
"As a personal maid, it is really unprofessional to not even know how to dress the master."
Ye Hai stretched out his hand and pointed at Liulicawa Chiyo who was in a dazed state next to him.
Anna lowered her head and glanced at Rurigawa Chiyo beside her with her peripheral vision, and responded softly: "I obey, Your Majesty the Earl."
She walked up to Rurigawa Chiyo and said in a calm tone: "Miss Rurigawa Chiyo, please pick up this doll first."
"There should be no debris on the floor of your lord's room."
Rurigawa Chiyo subconsciously bent down and picked up the black and white bear doll. When her fingertips touched the soft fluff, she suddenly realized that her current appearance seemed unsuitable for seeing people.
She held the doll and froze in place, the tips of her ears so red that they almost bled.
But Anna seemed not to see anything, she just stepped aside to make way, her voice still calm: "The changing room is over here, please follow me."
The dressing room is right next to the bedroom, just open the secret door.
The inside is twice as big as the bedroom, with an entire wall covered by a floor-to-ceiling wardrobe, and the other wall is filled with a huge dressing mirror and rows of drawers.
"I have prepared the clothes that Lord Earl will wear today, but you may have to do the task of choosing clothes later."
"I hope you can have good taste and don't let us, the Earl, lose etiquette in front of our subjects."
